rules.bar: noise bar = 3 x the larger combined probe SD (seed + image bootstrap, the W5 recipe) at that readout: row/col windows use Dref_row's row probe and Dref_col's column probe (RB-0's bar); the cref window uses Cref's row and column probes
rules.label: a single head 'favours' rows if its row cost (row window, row probe) is above the bar AND exceeds its column cost (col window, column probe) by more than the bar; columns likewise; 'mixed' if a cost is above the bar but neither gap is; 'none' if both costs are within the bar (the grey of Figure 4d)
rules.readout: primary readout: entering block 11 for heads in blocks 6-10; output of block 11 for block-11 heads

scores.ssdc_b11: SSDC lost entering block 11 vs Cref (the paper's rebuilding score applied to one head)
scores.probe_b11: row + column probe points lost entering block 11 vs Cref, in the cref window (primary probe score)
scores.axis_b11: row cost (row window) + column cost (col window) entering block 11 (Figure 4d's two axes, summed)

rules.next: Later runs that pick 'top' single heads (RB-3 onward) rank heads in blocks 6-10 by probe_b11 if, on at least two of naver ViT-B, naver ViT-S and reg1-gap, the 95% bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples of the heads) of rho(probe_b11, top-1 cost) - rho(ssdc_b11, top-1 cost) lies above zero; otherwise by ssdc_b11. Block-11 heads are ranked separately, at the output of block 11. Top-1 cost = RB-0 part C.
